source.rule: Subsystem QTYPM and ENVF propagate failure frequency through SystemStructure; a subsystem can be a tightly linked part of a deployed top system. QTYPM may also propagate task frequency, so PM outcomes are secondary and separately described.

panel.missions: unchanged h8, h20, h32 starts on one deployed top aircraft

single_factor_variants.qty-two: Only TEACH-SUB-B SystemStructure QTYPM=2 relative to same-seed baseline, apart from description
single_factor_variants.env-two: Only TEACH-SUB-B SystemStructure ENVF=2.0 relative to same-seed baseline, apart from description

pre_run_analysis.primary_outcome: Aggregate total-unit/total-system SystemResults NFAIL summed over 120 nonoverlapping half-hour bins, per 256 replications for each arm and seed.
pre_run_analysis.uncertainty: For twelve matched seeds, report each paired difference, arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, and Student t 95% interval. Exact one-sided sign test counts strictly positive differences; zeros are nonpositive. Bonferroni threshold 0.025 per contrast.
pre_run_analysis.acceptance_direction: Both contrasts require positive mean difference and exact one-sided sign-test p < 0.025. Magnitude is descriptive; no exact rate multiplier or arm equivalence is claimed.
pre_run_analysis.diagnostic_gate: Before the full panel, run seed 2 baseline once. If conversion rejects the model, output is invalid, or relevant warning is unclassified, seal and report the diagnostic without running the remaining panel or publishing a positive result. A corrected contract/input must receive a new version and unique run ID.

native_acceptance: Each run uses guarded session-0 SSH, host-wide queue mutex, and preserves GUI PID13340 and the original Prelife Log option.
Each run has exact authored populated-table import/export roundtrip, zero conversion errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty valid SXO, event log and report.
Input and run source hashes and every local raw artifact are sealed; source and closure remain stable.
Independent read-only reviewer checks source contrast, raw seals, per-run metrics, statistical contrasts and scope without importing author validator.
limits: This panel addresses aggregate failure-frequency propagation for one directly repairable child B in one two-child composite. It does not prove physical multiplicity, exact rate doubling, or equal mechanisms for QTYPM and ENVF.
The native event log records only the first replication of a multi-replication run. Aggregate per-subsystem causation and other child repair policies are not inferred from it.
Failure-induced effects on sibling operation, wrong-level repair/PM, GUI visuals, and cross-engine parity require separate evidence.
